body:
## What does this PR do?

Recover source-update GitHub reads from a single cold-connection timeout instead of aborting stable release resolution. Use a 30-second per-attempt socket timeout and retry a typed timeout once, including urllib-wrapped timeouts. Exhaustion still fails; HTTP status errors retain their existing policy and the 401 anonymous fallback.

## Related Issue

Part of #139176. Delivers the raised default, one timeout retry and timeout copy derived from the same constant. Does not introduce a configurable timeout. No claim that every proxy failure recovers.

Overlap checked: #90638 changes git probes; #124684 changes R2 channel reads; #127279 installs OS trust at module entry; #127943 changes response-size handling. Their inspected changes do not implement this timeout recovery. Those contracts remain untouched.

## Type of Change

- [x] Bug fix

## Changes Made

- `hermes_cli/source_check.py`: one retry of direct/wrapped `TimeoutError`, preserving headers, decoding and the response-size bound.
- `hermes_cli/github_api.py`: shared 30-second socket timeout and per-attempt timeout wording (not a total wall-clock promise).
- `tests/hermes_cli/test_source_http_timeout.py`: real stable resolver path with a deterministic transport fixture and error/caller boundaries.

## How to Test

Base: `73b9f2af7b87a619f42396710c332be04353aef2`.

`scripts/run_tests.sh -j 1 --file-retries 0 tests/hermes_cli/test_source_http_timeout.py`

Native Windows, existing Python 3.11.15 interpreter, temporary HOME/USERPROFILE/HERMES_HOME/APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA:
- Base RED: 2 expected failures, stable lookup aborts with `api.github.com did not answer within 10 seconds`; 4 HTTP-policy controls pass.
- Focused GREEN: 11 passed, 0 failed. Covers direct/wrapped timeout, exhaustion, token retention, 401 fallback, 403/429/500 no-retry, empty/BOM response and close, non-timeout transport refusal, shared budget/copy consistency.
- `git diff --check` passed.

Post-publication verification on the same head:
- `test_source_check.py` + `test_stable_lookup_github_auth.py`: 45 passed.
- `test_source_release_probe.py`: 3 passed.
- Disposable real loopback HTTP probe: held the first connection until the retry arrived; stable resolution then succeeded after three requests (release retry plus commit lookup), with the same authorization. Socket budget shortened to 0.2 seconds for the fixture. This is not a real TLS proxy test.

Validation limits: the initial five-file broader invocation exceed
title: fix(update): retry a timed-out source API read once
